verdict.rationale: Vercel publishes a live OpenAPI spec at vercel.com/openapi.json (confirmed via probe returning an 'openapi' key), documents its REST API, and even directs agents to it via llms.txt ('read the OpenAPI description ... before choosing an operation'). missing for 10: no independent/community corroboration of the OpenAPI spec's completeness or third-party usage confirming it works in practice.
